method.name: UpdateInterval
method.description: Returns interval in seconds for updating meters across several frames; 1 second by default.

method.name: SetUpdateInterval
method.description: Sets interval in seconds for updating values.

method.name: IsLongLineFormat
method.description: Prefer longer lines over more greater of lines.

method.name: SetLongLineFormat
method.description: Set if format should prefer longer lines over greater number of lines.

method.name: FrameDuration
method.description: Returns duration of the last frame in seconds.

method.name: FrameRate
method.description: Returns FPS (frames per seconds, elapsed time). This number indicates an actual frame rate averaged for several frames within UpdateInterval() duration, basing on a real elapsed time between updates.

method.name: FrameRateCpu
method.description: Returns CPU FPS (frames per seconds, CPU time). This number indicates a PREDICTED frame rate, basing on CPU elapsed time between updates and NOT real elapsed time (which might include periods of CPU inactivity). Number is expected to be greater then actual frame rate returned by FrameRate(). Values significantly greater actual frame rate indicate that rendering is limited by GPU performance (CPU is stalled in-between), while values around actual frame rate indicate rendering being limited by CPU performance (GPU is stalled in-between).

method.name: CounterValue
method.description: Returns value of specified counter, cached between stats updates. Should NOT be called between ::FrameStart() and ::FrameEnd() calls.

method.name: TimerValue
method.description: Returns value of specified timer for modification, should be called between ::FrameStart() and ::FrameEnd() calls. Should NOT be called between ::FrameStart() and ::FrameEnd() calls.

method.name: HasCulledLayers
method.description: Returns TRUE if some Layers have been culled.

method.name: HasCulledStructs
method.description: Returns TRUE if some structures have been culled.

method.name: LastDataFrame
method.description: Returns last data frame, cached between stats updates. Should NOT be called between ::FrameStart() and ::FrameEnd() calls.

method.name: ChangeTimer
method.description: Returns value of specified timer for modification, should be called between ::FrameStart() and ::FrameEnd() calls.
